data.name: Search knowledge base
data.description:
Searches the Knowledge Base and returns items most relevant to the provided natural language query.
Documentation: https://developers.jasper.ai/reference/searchknowledge
Quick Start:
- Ensure {{apiKey}} is set.
- POST a JSON body with query to /v1/knowledge/search.
Parameters Explained:
- Request body (JSON):
  - query (required, string): Natural language search query to find relevant Knowledge items.
Common Errors & Fixes:
- 400 Bad Request: Missing query or malformed JSON body.
- 401/403: Missing or invalid API key.
- 500: Server error during search.
Edge Cases:
- Natural language search returns results by semantic relevance; exact keyword matches are not guaranteed.
- Very long queries may be truncated or rejected.
Rate Limits & Constraints:
- Search endpoints may have separate rate limits; consult Rate Limits documentation.

data.name: Search Knowledge Base
data.description:
Search the TRIBE knowledge base for saved patterns, notes, and reusable artifacts.
Documentation: https://tribecode.ai/docs/muse
Quick Start:
- Use query parameters such as category and tags to scope your search.
- Include Authorization: Bearer {{accessToken}} in the request header.
Parameters:
- category (optional): Filter by knowledge base category (e.g., pattern).
- tags (optional): Comma-separated tags to filter results (e.g., cors,bugfix).
Common Errors & Fixes:
- 401 Unauthorized: Missing/invalid API key.
- 400 Bad Request: Invalid parameter formats.
Edge Cases:
- Tag matching may be exact or partial depending on backend indexing (not documented here).
- Some knowledge items may be private and require permissions.
Rate Limits & Constraints:
- Subject to collection-level rate limits described in API Reference.

data.name: Search Knowledge Bases
data.description:
Search knowledge bases by name or query string. Returns a list of matching knowledge bases and their document details.
Documentation: https://docs.askyourpdf.com/askyourpdf-docs
Quick Start:
- GET /v1/api/search/knowledge?query=YOUR_QUERY with x-api-key.
Parameters Explained:
- query (required, query): Search string to filter knowledge bases by name.
Common Errors & Fixes:
- 422 Validation Error: missing query parameter.
- 401 Unauthorized: invalid API key.
Edge Cases:
- Matches are returned based on name/document metadata; relevance ranking not documented.
Rate Limits & Constraints:
- Search requests count toward API usage.
data.evaluateGuide:

Use for: find a knowledge base, search by name, inspect document metadata
Not supported: searching document text, uploading documents, editing knowledge bases

data.name: Search Knowledge Base Articles
data.description:
Searches articles in a public knowledge base and returns matching article records.
Documentation: https://doc.groovehq.com/knowledge-base-public
Quick Start:
- No authentication required (public endpoints).
- Call the GET endpoint with the knowledge base ID in the path and provide the required keyword query parameter.
Parameters Explained:
- knowledgeBaseId (required, path): The ID of the knowledge base to search (string).
- keyword (required, query): The search keyword. Use * to return all articles.
- categoryId (optional, query): Filter results to a specific category ID.
- featured (optional, query): Boolean to filter only featured articles.
- ids (optional, query): Array of article IDs to restrict results to.
- page (optional, query): Page number of results. Default: 1.
- perPage (optional, query): Number of results per page. Default: 25.
- tag (optional, query): Filter results by tag name.
Common Errors & Fixes:
- 404 Not Found: Knowledge base is password/IP restricted or knowledgeBaseId is incorrect.
- 400 Bad Request: Missing required keyword parameter or malformed query parameter types.
Edge Cases:
- When using ids, supply an array of IDs; behavior for mixed invalid IDs is undocumented.
- featured expects a boolean value; string representations may not be accepted.
Rate Limits & Constraints:
- The documentation does not list explicit rate limits for this endpoint on this page.
data.evaluateGuide:
Searches articles in a public Groove knowledge base by keyword, with optional category and featured filters. Use * to return all articles.
Use for: find public articles, filter by category, list featured content
Not supported: private article search, article creation, article editing

data.name: Search Knowledge Base Articles
data.description:
Search articles in a knowledge base using various filters and pagination.
Documentation: https://doc.groovehq.com/knowledge-base-articles
Quick Start:
- Provide knowledgeBaseId and a keyword value (use * to return all articles).
- Include optional filters (authorid, categoryid, featured, ids, order, page, per_page, state, tag, unpaginated).
Parameters Explained:
- keyword (query, required): Keyword to search articles by. Use * for all.
- author_id (query, optional): Filter results by author ID.
- category_id (query, optional): Filter by category ID.
- featured (query, optional): true/false to filter featured articles.
- ids (query, optional): Array of article IDs to limit results.
- order (query, optional): Sort by a field and direction, e.g. title:asc or updated_at:desc.
- page (query, optional, default 1): Page number.
- per_page (query, optional, default 25): Results per page.
- state (query, optional): Article state filter (draft, published, wip, deleted).
- tag (query, optional): Tag name to filter by.
- unpaginated (query, optional, default false): Return unpaginated results (max 100).
Common Errors & Fixes:
- 401 Unauthorized: Missing/invalid token. Ensure Authorization header is set.
- 400 Bad Request: Invalid query param values (e.g., non-integer page/per_page).
Edge Cases:
- unpaginated=true returns at most 100 results.
- Sorting fields are limited to documented sortable fields (average_ratings, position, title, updated_at).
Rate Limits & Constraints:
- Not documented on this page.
data.evaluateGuide:
Searches Groove knowledge-base articles with keyword, author, category, status, tag, ordering, and pagination filters.
Use for: search articles, filter by author, list tagged content, paginate results
Not supported: creating articles, editing articles, deleting knowledge
